Nina (CS): Hey team — SolaceBio is prepping a customer showcase next Thurs. They want APAC enablement (primary sg, fallback tok), a temporary demo key, and a short burst window: 2026-04-07 10:00-13:00 SGT. Request: 400 qps for 3h, IPs 203.0.113.99/32 and 198.51.100.77/32, plus CORS for https://demo.solacebio.ai. They also asked for scoped key limited to model=v2-lite and event-level logs turned off. @Priya @Jonas @Ruth can we do this?
Haruto (SolaceBio): Confirming details. We'll be running parallel live sessions (~30 attendees) with streaming turned on. Can we also add a short DNS pin so traffic prefers sg then falls back to tok? Need the demo token no later than 24h before the session.
Priya (Eng Infra): We can create an ap-southeast-1 route and a failover to ap-northeast-1 with tenant pinning. For 400 qps sustained, recommend reserving 3x g4dn equivalent. If streaming concurrency is high, we might want 4. I'll queue a reserve.
Jonas (SRE): I'll reserve 3 nodes and set autoscale: min=3 max=5, scale trigger p95 latency>600ms for 2m. Will also add network ACL entries to staging. Need CS to confirm signed Demo Agreement before pushing to prod ACL.
Ruth (Security): Demo Agreement + a short security addendum needed. We'll scope the token to the CIDRs and to model=v2-lite, set retention=0 for request logs, and disable request-level debugging. Also recommend mTLS for demo endpoints if they can support it. Nina, can you get the signed doc?
Nina (CS): I'll send the Demo Agreement and the one-page security addendum now. Haruto — please sign and return by EOD today; otherwise we can't guarantee prod ACL push. We'll include quick instructions and the limited demo key when doc is returned.
Haruto (SolaceBio): We'll sign today. Two quick asks: can the demo key be time-bound (expire 4h after the window) and can you whitelist only the two IPs, not full subnets?
Ruth (Security): Time-bound keys are standard. We'll issue token scoped: allowed_ips=["203.0.113.99/32","198.51.100.77/32"], expires=2026-04-07T17:00:00Z, model="v2-lite", retention=0. I'll open ticket SEC-7892.
Jonas (SRE): Provisioned reserve: 3x g4dn in ap-southeast-1, failover route to ap-northeast-1. Autoscale policy applied. Staging ACL updated. Will push prod ACL after Nina confirms signed docs.
Priya (Eng Infra): Proxy config we'll apply after sign-off (snippet):
```json
{
  "tenant": "solacebio",
  "primary_region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "fallback_region": "ap-northeast-1",
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.99/32", "198.51.100.77/32"],
  "cors": ["https://demo.solacebio.ai"],
  "qps_limit": 400,
  "token_constraints": {"model": "v2-lite", "retention": 0, "expires": "2026-04-07T17:00:00Z"}
}
```
Nina (CS): Sending Demo Agreement + security addendum to Haruto now. Sales flagged this account as 'renewal at risk' — they want a strong demo. If this goes well, sales will re-engage for a Q2 renewal push.
deploy-bot: Route creation requested: route-solacebio-ap-southeast-1 queued at 4135790009 by Jonas (SRE)
Jonas (SRE): I'll monitor the window. Alerts set for cpu>70%, p95 latency>700ms, error-rate>0.5%. If any threshold trips, I'll scale to max immediately. Ping #eng-sre during demo and I'll respond.
Haruto (SolaceBio): Thanks everyone — signing now. We'll upload signed doc to the secure share and ping Nina. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Nina (CS): Great — once doc is in, I'll confirm prod ACL push and hand over the scoped token. Good luck with the demo!
